name: pluxel
description: A TypeScript plugin runtime with dependency graphs, lifecycle management, static delivery, and dynamic development workflows.

scripts.lint: oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error packages plugins projects scripts oxlint.config.ts pncat.config.ts && pnpm run lint:frontend-types
scripts.lint:frontend-types: oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --type-aware -A correctness -A suspicious -A perf -D typescript/await-thenable -D typescript/no-array-delete -D typescript/no-base-to-string -D typescript/no-floating-promises -D typescript/no-for-in-array -D typescript/no-misused-promises -D typescript/no-misused-spread -D typescript/only-throw-error -D typescript/prefer-promise-reject-errors -D typescript/use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable packages/workbench-app/src packages/valibot-form/src/web
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error packages plugins projects scripts oxlint.config.ts pncat.config.ts --fix
scripts.verify: pnpm run governance:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm exec turbo run typecheck build test --concurrency=50%
